description: Delicate pink proposal-style general presentation template: soft blush pink and warm white with deep burgundy/wine text, Georgia serif headlines, wide-tracked uppercase kickers, a whisper of script accents, thin wine rules, soft arch frames and generous whitespace. Cover, agenda, big statement, text with diamond bullets, two-column comparison, stat band, quote, arched SVG botanical interlude (fully offline), offline video slot, and closing — with the A−/100%/A+ font control. No gradients, no lesson timeline: built as a general Canva substitute.
fonts: Snell Roundhand / Brush Script MT (script accents, sparing)
name: Blush
